{"initial_observation":{"company":"CLOSE_fin_04","message":"The ledger is accessed through the supplied SQL tools.","storage_note":"Pandas materializes recorded_at as SQLite YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS timestamps. Compare timestamps semantically, for example datetime(recorded_at)<=datetime(cutoff). Raw lexical comparison with a T-separated cutoff changes same-day ordering."},"max_actions":10,"task":"Company CLOSE_fin_04 keeps a single heterogeneous ledger table. Every record type is stored in ledger, so SQL self-joins and CTEs can be used. Close the payable ledger as it was known at recorded_at <= 2026-10-24T12:00:00, for business_date <= 2026-10-23. All timestamps are UTC ISO text. Start by excluding rows with future business dates and rows recorded late, then keep only the highest revision for each (kind,event_key). If that latest row has status void, the key is removed entirely; never fall back to an older row. Invoice rows use event_key as the invoice ID; payment, credit and hold rows use invoice_id to point to their parent invoice. Keep the active invoices for vendor BLUE with due_date <= 2026-10-30. Payments and credits reduce the gross amount_minor, in the invoice currency. Active holds reduce the remaining amount; holds with status release or void do not. Clamp as follows: remaining=max(0,gross-sum(payments)-sum(credits)), then unheld=max(0,remaining-sum(active holds)). For each invoice, pick the active terms row that has the same terms_code and the greatest business_date <= the invoice business_date (applying the same revision and as-of filtering). The discounted amount is unheld * (10000-discount_bps)/10000 only when 2026-10-23 <= discount_until; otherwise it is unheld. Next, pick the active FX row for that invoice's currency with the greatest business_date <= the invoice business_date. Convert to USD cents using fx_num/fx_den. Round only this final per-invoice amount to the nearest cent, rounding exact halves up. Sum the rounded per-invoice USD cents. Invoices in USD also have FX rows. Do not net invoices together before rounding. Submit only the integer number of USD cents.","task_id":"fin-04","tools":[{"description":"Get a list of available table names for a company.","name":"get_descriptions","parameters":{"additionalProperties":false,"properties":{"company_name":{"description":"The name of the company","type":"string"}},"required":["company_name"],"type":"object"}},{"description":"Get table metadata: description, columns, types, unique values.","name":"get_table_info","parameters":{"additionalProperties":false,"properties":{"company_name":{"description":"The name of the company","type":"string"},"table_name":{"description":"The name of the table","type":"string"}},"required":["company_name","table_name"],"type":"object"}},{"description":"Execute a SQL query on a table. {"tool":"sql_query","arguments":{"company_name":"CLOSE_fin_04","table_name":"ledger","query":"WITH eligible AS (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY kind,event_key ORDER BY revision DESC) AS rn FROM ledger WHERE business_date <= '2026-10-23' AND datetime(recorded_at) <= datetime('2026-10-24T12:00:00')), active AS (SELECT * FROM eligible WHERE rn=1 AND status <> 'void'), invoices AS (SELECT * FROM active WHERE kind='invoice' AND vendor='BLUE' AND due_date <= '2026-10-30'), calc AS (SELECT i.event_key, i.currency, i.amount_minor, i.discount_until, t.discount_bps, f.fx_num, f.fx_den, MAX(0, i.amount_minor-COALESCE((SELECT SUM(p.amount_minor) FROM active p WHERE p.kind='payment' AND p.invoice_id=i.event_key),0)-COALESCE((SELECT SUM(c.amount_minor) FROM active c WHERE c.kind='credit' AND c.invoice_id=i.event_key),0)) AS remaining FROM invoices i LEFT JOIN active t ON t.kind='terms' AND t.event_key=(SELECT t2.event_key FROM active t2 WHERE t2.kind='terms' AND t2.terms_code=i.terms_code AND t2.business_date<=i.business_date ORDER BY t2.business_date DESC LIMIT 1) LEFT JOIN active f ON f.kind='fx' AND f.event_key=(SELECT f2.event_key FROM active f2 WHERE f2.kind='fx' AND f2.currency=i.currency AND f2.business_date<=i.business_date ORDER BY f2.business_date DESC LIMIT 1)) SELECT event_key, currency, amount_minor, remaining, MAX(0, remaining-COALESCE((SELECT SUM(h.amount_minor) FROM active h WHERE h.kind='hold' AND h.invoice_id=calc.event_key AND h.status NOT IN ('release','void')),0)) AS unheld, discount_bps, fx_num, fx_den, CASE WHEN discount_until >= '2026-10-23' THEN discount_bps ELSE 0 END AS applied_discount_bps, CAST((MAX(0, remaining-COALESCE((SELECT SUM(h.amount_minor) FROM active h WHERE h.kind='hold' AND h.invoice_id=calc.event_key AND h.status NOT IN ('release','void')),0)) * (10000-CASE WHEN discount_until >= '2026-10-23' THEN discount_bps ELSE 0 END) * fx_num * 2 + fx_den*10000)/(2*fx_den*10000) AS INTEGER) AS usd_cents FROM calc WHERE fx_den > 0"}}
